title: 037 4-of-8 vote with the C2 ATR take-profit: alone (vs gbb) and beside the width book -- does the exit explain the plain arm's FAIL?
label: PROVISIONAL -- one era (2023-26); the vote was chosen and confirmed with the late half in view (037 tradeable-bars M-of-N screen), so the late half is NOT blind. Nothing is adopted. The plain arm (st_mofn48) FAILED before this file was written; this arm changes only the exit.

why_these.st_mofn48_c2: st_mofn48 FAILED (alone -15.28 vs gbb 11.04; take-profit reached on 30% of trades vs gbb 42%, 12 h unclog 25% vs 16%): the vote was chosen on the ATR-scaled label, the arm paid fixed-% exits. C2 (028, 2.897 x ATR clamped [1%, 5%]) is the repo's adopted ATR take-profit; no other value is tried.
